visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown wavy hair, wearing a light blue oversized long-sleeved shirt and green shorts, struggles to move a massive, heavy cardboard box wrapped in plastic in a modern kitchen. She pushes it with her legs and back against the floor. (2) She sits on a gray couch in a living room with various colorful plush toys behind her, talking to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (3) She begins pulling clothing items out of a large clear plastic bag, showcasing a black puff-sleeved dress with a front zipper and bow detail. (4) She holds up a light blue shirt and points out a small stain or mark on the fabric, expressing visible disappointment through her facial expressions. (5) She shows a cat sitting on the couch while holding several packaged items. (6) She demonstrates a large gray makeup organizer with multiple slots and a black makeup bag with pink ribbons, pointing out technical flaws and material quality. (7) She poses with a large blue denim tote bag on her shoulder. (8) She unboxes a pair of wide-leg denim jeans and a large toy set for a children's ice cream shop. (9) She tries on the black dress, which appears very tight around her midsection, and she gestures toward the zipper. (10) She throws the gray makeup bag toward the ground in frustration and concludes by sitting on the couch.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long wavy brown hair wearing an oversized light blue button-down shirt and later a black puff-sleeve dress.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo upbeat electronic music begins. A sequence of quick percussive impact sounds coincides with visual struggles with a heavy box. (2) Vocal narration starts at a high speech rate with a friendly and energetic tone. A cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect triggers as text appears. (3) Transition to a slightly more rhythmic BGM. Distinct high-frequency plastic rustling sounds are heard as items are unpacked. (4) A comic 'ding' sound effect occurs when she points at a stain. Her voice adopts a slightly mock-sad, exaggerated tone. (5) A brief melodic stinger or circus-like motif plays during the cat appearance. (6) Vocal intensity increases as she criticizes the makeup bags, ending in a loud, shouted exclamation with comedic distorted SFX. (7) Audio ends with a quick ascending musical jingle and a final percussive thud.
